title: a16z Podcast: When Banking Works Like My Smartphone

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: There are fewer and fewer parts of our lives that don't feel like an extension of our smartphones.
reader_summary.overview: There are fewer and fewer parts of our lives that don't feel like an extension of our smartphones. All served up simply, quickly, at the right price, and with an experience that is actually enjoyable. And then there is the world of banking.

key_points.text: Taavet Hinrikus, CEO and co-founder of money transfer company TransferWise.
